# Security policy

These bookmarklets run inside the pages you use them on, so a flaw can
expose those pages' data. Please report vulnerabilities privately via
GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/binary-poetry/01_bookmarklets/security/advisories/new)
(Security tab → "Report a vulnerability"), not in a public issue.

Only the latest tag of each bookmarklet (`<id>@<version>`) is supported.
A fix gets a new tag and a new published hash; a bookmark you already
dragged doesn't update itself, so drag the fixed version again.
